project_type: Kiro Crew - a persistent local agent workspace. Python Gateway (long-running background process) plus Electron desktop shell. This task concerns the Python Gateway process (python.exe on Windows).
build_system: setuptools (setup.py, setup.cfg, pyproject.toml). Makefile / make.ps1 wrap common tasks (make build creates a .venv). Node/Electron parts are not in scope for this task.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio and hypothesis. Root conftest.py (~121KB) provides shared fixtures and imports hypothesis + numpy + other heavy deps at import time. Tests live under test/. Existing relevant tests: test/test_embeddings.py (fakes the vendored Llama class, never loads a real model, never hits network), test/test_embedder_decode_429.py, test/test_folder_watcher.py, test/test_custom_embedding_model.py, test/test_enable_embeddings_faiss.py.
build_command: make build (creates .venv, installs deps). NOT runnable in this sandbox: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode blocks PyPI, so dependency install fails (verified: pip install hypothesis returns 403 Forbidden tunnel).
test_command: Full suite: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest test/ (requires numpy, hypothesis, aiohttp, etc. that are NOT installable in this sandbox). Targeted alternative that WORKS in-sandbox: use pyenv interpreter at ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python (has pytest 9.1.1) and run focused test files that avoid the heavy root conftest via: PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest <newtest> -p no:cacheprovider --confcutdir=<dir> -o addopts=''. The modules under test (kiro_crew.embeddings, kiro_crew.knowledge.embedder) import with the standard library only (verified).
verification_instructions: Because the live Windows desktop repro cannot be reproduced in this Linux sandbox with no external network, verification is: (1) targeted pytest on new/changed unit tests using the pyenv 3.11.15 interpreter with fakes for the vendored Llama class; (2) AST/import sanity: PYTHONPATH=src <py> -c 'import kiro_crew.embeddings, kiro_crew.knowledge.embedder'; (3) a buffer-size assertion test that verifies the embedder constructs the vendored Llama with an n_batch that bounds the scores/logits allocation. Do NOT attempt to download the 610MB GGUF model or run real inference.
setup_instructions: In-sandbox: use ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python (pytest preinstalled). Run targeted tests with PYTHONPATH=src and bypass the root conftest (which needs numpy/hypothesis) by placing new tests in a directory with its own minimal conftest or using --confcutdir and -o addopts=''. Do NOT run make build (network-blocked).
environment_constraints: NETWORK: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no PyPI, no model download, no external HTTP (verified pip 403). Full pytest suite cannot run (numpy/hypothesis/aiohttp missing and uninstallable). The live symptom (Windows desktop, 50+ skills, local git-clone knowledge sources, Telegram, RSS 600MB->3GB in 10 min) CANNOT be reproduced here. All investigation and fixes are driven from source analysis and targeted unit tests with fakes. Default `python` is not on PATH via pyenv shim; use python3.12 or ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python explicitly.
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md present at repo root. Changes go on a branch; the orchestrator handles push/PR. Reference issue #6827 in commits. Do not add a CHANGELOG entry unless the repo convention requires it for fixes (recent fix PRs like #3824 explicitly dropped CHANGELOG entries).
key_patterns: Embedding runtime: kiro_crew/embeddings.py holds LlamaCppEmbedder (serialized single owned inference thread kc-embed-infer; one shared ~700MB model). The vendored llama.cpp runtime is at src/kiro_crew/_vendor/llama_cpp/llama.py. KEY FINDING: LlamaCppEmbedder._load_model (embeddings.py ~line 1327) constructs the vendored Llama with embedding=True, n_ctx=_N_CTX(2048), n_batch=_N_CTX(2048), n_ubatch=_N_UBATCH(512). The vendored Llama.__init__ (llama.py ~line 476-478) eagerly allocates self.scores = np.ndarray((n_batch, n_vocab), float32) because the constructor's logits_all defaults to False -> shape (2048, ~151000) ~= 1.24 GB of numpy that the embedding path NEVER reads (embeddings are read via llama_get_embeddings_seq in Llama.embed, not from self.scores). Llama.embed() already calls kv_cache_clear()+reset() after every call, so per-call KV growth is bounded. Config: memory.embedding_provider is coerced by config/loader.py _coerce_embedding_provider; setting it to "" is a documented diagnostic that falls back to keyword/FTS search (see knowledge/embedder.create_embedder_from_config and vector_memory._try_embed). Diagnostics: kiro_crew/perf_sampler.py already supports py-spy and in-process sampling; the issue asks for tracemalloc/py-spy a few minutes into the climb.
directory_structure: src/kiro_crew/ = Gateway source. embeddings.py = in-process embedding runtime + model download. _vendor/llama_cpp/ = vendored llama-cpp-python (llama.py has the Llama class and its scores/logits buffer allocation). knowledge/ = knowledge library ingest/index (folder_watcher.py watches local git clones via SQLite folder_file_state; ingestion.py, store.py, llm_pool.py spawns kiro-cli subprocess workers = issue #3259, out of scope). vector_memory.py = semantic memory with background backfill/consolidation. skills.py = SkillsLoader with bounded per-path frontmatter/iter caches (shared, not per-session). test/ = pytest suite.
